Class Punishment

java.lang.Object
com.phase2.GameObjects.GameObject
com.phase2.Punishments.Punishment
Direct Known Subclasses:
Chocolate, Onion, Whiskey
public abstract class Punishment extends GameObject
The Punishment class represents a type of enemy or harmful object in the game that applies a penalty to the player upon interaction.

This is an abstract class that serves as a base for all specific punishment types. Subclasses must define the specific behavior and rendering logic for the punishment.
